outputComponents.text:
I've updated the mobile homepage to ensure all Pro-tier features are clearly labeled as "planned" or "waitlist" only.

**Key Changes:**
- **Feature Updates:** Replaced "Unlimited generations" with "Higher monthly limits (planned)" and "Custom context injection" with "Saved client snippets (planned)."
- **Waitlist Labeling:** Added "(planned)" suffixes to all Pro features to maintain transparency and manage user expectations.
- **CTA Refinement:** Updated the Pro button to "Join Waitlist" to align with the current beta status and avoid any implication of immediate access or checkout.
- **Visual Integrity:** Preserved the Calm Inbox Desk aesthetic, including the warm paper background and teal brand colors, while ensuring mobile usability.

The word "unlimited" has been removed entirely to keep the messaging grounded and honest.

outputComponents.suggestion: Apply these changes to the desktop version too
Update the Pricing page with the same wording
Change the waitlist button to a primary teal color
